bio: Nobody expects a powerful wizard to cheat at cards, but Anarose has never let chance dictate her fate… which might be fine, if she didn’t keep sneaking off to the worst gambling dens in Freeport to remind ‘chance’ of her opinion. She’d be dead long ago – but her magic goes far beyond card games.
